mapper.sql: id, owner_id, root_entry_id, token_hash, access_code_hash, access_code_encrypted, permission, is_recursive, download_requires_auth, expires_at, revoked_at, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO share_link ( id, owner_id, root_entry_id, token_hash, access_code_hash, access_code_encrypted, permission, is_recursive, download_requires_auth, expires_at, revoked_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{share.id}, #{share.ownerId}, #{share.rootEntryId}, #{share.tokenHash}, #{share.accessCodeHash}, #{share.accessCodeEncrypted}, #{share.permission}, #{share.recursive}, #{share.downloadRequiresAuth}, #{share.expiresAt}, #{share.revokedAt}, #{share.createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM share_link WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM share_link WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM share_link WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM share_link WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT DISTINCT root_entry_id FROM share_link WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND root_entry_id IN
#{entryId}
mapper.update: UPDATE share_link SET access_code_hash = #{share.accessCodeHash}, access_code_encrypted = #{share.accessCodeEncrypted}, permission = #{share.permission}, is_recursive = #{share.recursive}, download_requires_auth = #{share.downloadRequiresAuth}, expires_at = #{share.expiresAt}, revoked_at = NULL WHERE owner_id = #{share.ownerId} AND root_entry_id = #{share.rootEntryId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS share_id, COALESCE(SUM( l.access_action = 'VIEW' AND l.succeeded = 1 ), 0) AS visits, COALESCE(SUM( l.access_action = 'DOWNLOAD' AND l.succeeded = 1 ), 0) AS downloads FROM share_link s LEFT JOIN share_access_log l ON l.share_id = s.id WHERE s.owner_id = #{ownerId} GROUP BY s.id
